title: LIFT Run Heart Rate
description: One heart rate reading, sent watch -> phone during a run the phone records (path B). The phone starts the watch app with HKHealthStore.startWatchApp(toHandle:); the watch runs an HKWorkoutSession, mirrors it to the phone, and sends one of these per new heart rate statistic with sendToRemoteWorkoutSession(data:). Each Data is this object as UTF-8 JSON; the phone reads them in didReceiveDataFromRemoteWorkoutSession. Tracked and shown, never targeted: the phone shows the latest and keeps only the run's average and max, never the readings. A bpm of zero or less is no reading and is dropped. See LiftSync's RunHeartRatePayload.

bpm.description: Beats per minute, rounded to a whole number. Zero or less is no reading.

at.description: When the reading was measured, ISO 8601 in UTC. Senders write whole seconds; readers accept fractional seconds too.
